body: Hi Alberto! Today I have installed a new version of Python, ie 3.13.13 (no _venv_!) on my **Win 11 25H2** PC which has **ART** **1.26.4** installed. I downloaded _spektrafilm sources_ and I run its configuration to get all its requirements. At the end of the process I tried to run its GUI (napari) and everything seems ok. I could upload, show and manage any image. Then I tried to see if it worked also with ART. So I downloaded your latest version of your scripts to inteface ART with spektrafilm, ie **ART_spektrafilm.json** and **spektrafilm_mklut.py**. I did not modify anything in them except for: `"command" : "python3 spektrafilm_mklut.py --server",` with ` "command" : "python.exe spektrafilm_mklut.py --server",` at **line 12** of ART_spektrafilm.json because I'wasn't sure that my python has this alias. In these conditions I was able to load the menu showing all kind of film simulations as reported in the image below However, when I tried to use whichever film simulation I have in the list, the script gives me an error/warning that I report in the image below. So it seems something is wrong with your script(s) at least in combination with the spektrafilm version 0.3.1. Have the best, Topoldo
title: Problems with latest spektrafilm source release and latest ART tools
